before.scope: Entire Node process per 480-case matrix, including startup/template preparation, all SDK replacements, all-page resolution, assets, retained report data and JSON output. OS maximum resident set, not engine-scoped heap, logical admission or sampled RSS.

after.scope: Entire Node process per 480-case matrix, including startup/template preparation, all SDK replacements, all-page resolution, assets, retained report data and JSON output. OS maximum resident set, not engine-scoped heap, logical admission or sampled RSS.

measurement: Single SDK replace sample per case with reused engine/assets; template preparation/startup and all-page resolution excluded. Memory is sampled after each snapshot, not a process high-water measurement. Whitespace and page count are context, not independent success criteria.

limits.reason: Public SDK does not expose per-case planner work counters. Actual native aggregate work counters are retained separately in planner-metrics.json; unchanged work bounds remain authoritative.
